title: Cabbage Steaks in Coffee and Spice Broth
subtitle: with hot labneh and crisp kale
description: Cabbage poached in a sweet, spicy coffee broth, roasted with a black coffee marinade and served on warm labneh with crisp kale and a creamy coffee sauce.

steps.text: Bring the water, ginger, celeriac, coriander root, allspice, peppercorns, dried chillies, brown sugar, granulated coffee and sea salt to the boil in a pot, reduce the heat and cook for about 20 minutes. Taste and adjust for a sweet and slightly spicy flavour. Add the cabbage (halved and sliced into 5 to 6 steaks) and simmer gently for about 10 more minutes until soft.
Strain the broth into a bowl and set aside. Cool the cabbage to room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 200°C (top and bottom heat) and line a tray with baking paper.
Mix the black coffee, 1/4 tsp salt, pepper and olive oil for the marinade.
Place the cabbage on the tray, brush each steak generously with the marinade (including between the leaves) and roast for about 15 minutes until golden.
For the hot labneh, mix the labneh, a pinch of salt, 1 chopped garlic clove and 1 chopped eschalot in a small pot and heat for about 5 minutes over medium heat to just below boiling.
For the kale, heat oil in a small pot and fry the kale leaves for a few seconds until they change colour and turn crisp. Season with salt and drain on paper towel.
For the sauce, cook 250 ml of the coffee broth with the cream and 1 chopped eschalot over low heat for about 20 minutes until it begins to reduce.
Place the hot labneh on a serving plate, top with the roasted cabbage and kale, drizzle with the sauce and serve immediately.
